Coram : ABHAY S. OKA*, AUGUSTINE GEORGE MASIH
Issue for Consideration Definition of Purchase Price under sub-Section (18) of Section 2 of the Gujarat Value Added Tax Act, 2003. High Court whether justified in upholding the order passed by the Gujarat Value Added Tax Tribunal wherein it held that the tax and value purchases on which no tax in the assessment could not be included in the aggregate of taxable turnover of purchases within the State of Gujarat for the purpose of reduction of tax credit.
